description: api.video enables you to easily build, scale and operate on-demand and live streaming videos in your app, software or platform.
tagline: api.video enables you to easily build, scale and operate on-demand and live streaming videos in your app, software or platform.
long_description: In the late 90s and early 2000s, images displaced text as we shifted towards image-driven communication. We're now see the same with video, enriching everything from shopping to online learning. Yet video was still incredibly complex for developers to implement, from encoding to hosting to distribution. While there were a few sales-driven enterprise products in this category, it lacked a bottom-up developer solution. We're strong believers that developers should be able to pick up infrastructure products and try them. api.video was founded by Cédric Montet who previously built Libcast, an online video platform, where he discoved the painpoints he set out to solve with api.video.
fundraising_note: Blossom led api.video’s $5.5M Seed round. They've since raised a $12M Series A.

description: Arrakis is building the AI Operating System for industrial operations, deploying AI agents into mission-critical workflows across the physical economy.
tagline: Arrakis is building the AI Operating System for industrial operations, deploying AI agents into mission-critical workflows across the physical economy.
long_description: The West is under pressure to reindustrialise, but its industrial champions run on decades-old software, fragmented systems and manual workflows. Arrakis pulls the messy data these operations run on into a single live model of the business, then deploys AI agents to execute workflows on top of it, with humans in the loop for critical decisions. Customers see results within weeks. Arrakis wins with a full-stack approach - forward-deployed engineers working as an extension of customers' teams, a model-agnostic AI platform, and an applied AI team that tunes models on each company's operational corpus - and solves for what industrial enterprises actually care about: business outcomes, sovereignty, and cost. Rafael Quintanilla spent time as an investor at Accel, working across defense and enterprise software. His co-founders (Haroun Beltaifa, Mikhail Galkov, and Romain Fouilland) have led procurement at Palantir, built ML infrastructure at DeliveryHero/Uber and re-designed G7 governments' emergency response systems.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Arrakis's $30m Series A

description: AutogenAI leverages generative AI to help companies write bids and tenders for public sector and corporate contracts.
tagline: AutogenAI leverages generative AI to help companies write bids and tenders for public sector and corporate contracts.
long_description: Bid writing has been at the heart of business-to-business and business-to-government procurement for decades. Using technology to make the process more efficient can result in big savings - bidding costs can easily account for 10% of the total contract value of a service. AutogenAI uses the extraordinary capabilities of large language models (LLMs) to supercharge the capacity of bid writing teams, allowing individuals to focus their energy on the strategic aspects of their bids. Founder Sean Williams started his career as a bid writer before going on to leading roles with some of the biggest suppliers of Government services. With a team of Prompt Engineers, Machine Learning Scientists and Writers, AutogenAI's software propels the transformation of procurement with intelligent time- and cost-effective solutions.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Autogen AI's $22.3M Series A round. They've since raised a $39.5M Series B co-led by Salesforce Ventures and Spark Capital.

description: Bleap is a self-custodial finance app that gives users a smarter way to spend, earn and trade.
tagline: Bleap is a self-custodial finance app that gives users a smarter way to spend, earn and trade.
long_description: As finance continues to evolve and on-chain transactions become more common, Bleap is bringing banking into the modern age. The team has built a self-custodial finance app designed for how money actually moves today — without unnecessary fees, delays, or restrictions. At the core of Bleap’s mission is making on-chain finance feel practical and familiar, whether you’re crypto-native or completely new to it. Bleap’s founders, João Alves and Guilherme Gomes, bring deep experience from their time at Revolut, where they helped build some of Europe’s most widely used financial products. Seeing firsthand both the progress and the limitations of traditional systems, they set out to tackle the problem head-on.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Bleap's $6m Seed round.

description: Cado captures forensic data from compromised systems and enables security analysts to rapidly sift through the evidence and collaborate on investigations.
tagline: Cado captures forensic data from compromised systems and enables security analysts to rapidly sift through the evidence and collaborate on investigations.
long_description: The aftermath of being hacked is one of the most stressful time for any enterprise company, yet despite $100bn in annual spend on security software, most companies find themselves having to perform forensics and post-attack investigation by hand, often taking days to start piecing together what happened, figure out the consequences and even if the attacker is still inside the company. Cado was founded by Chris Doman, who previously worked as a security engineer at AlienVault, Vectra Networks and PwC, and James Campbell who was director of PwC's Cyber Threat Detection & Response team.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Cado's $10M Series A round. Cado has since raised a $17M Series B led by Eurazeo. Acquired in 2025 by DarkTrace.

description: Castor reinvents the way companies find and understand their way around data.
tagline: Castor reinvents the way companies find and understand their way around data.
long_description: Data within companies has grown exponentially, the challenge for users is no-longer "do I have the data I need", but what data they should be using and how. Castor is building the data discovery and collaboration platform for business users, ensuring they can be truly data-driven. Castor, based out of Paris, was founded by four data scientists, Tristan Mayer, Xavier de Boisredon, Arnaud de Turckheim and Amaury Dumoulin. Two of whom had previously seen challenges first-hand as the Heads of Data at french unicorns Payfit and Qonto.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Castor's $23.5M Series A round. Acquired in 2025 by Coalesce.

description: Checkout’s mission is to build the future of commerce by building by a full stack technology that offers access to a payment gateway, advanced risk and fraud monitoring tools, a cutting-edge processor and the relevant acquirers, all in unified payments solution.
tagline: Checkout’s mission is to build the future of commerce by building by a full stack technology that offers access to a payment gateway, advanced risk and fraud monitoring tools, a cutting-edge processor and the relevant acquirers, all in unified payments solution.
long_description: The future of commerce is online & international. At the same time, companies increasingly need and want to embed financial products into their services. Checkout is enabling the payment rails and financial services for tomorrow's internet economy. Checkout was founded by Guillaume Pousaz who has been in payments since 2006. In 2009 he acquired a small payments company authorized to accept credit cards but which had zero technology. That small company, today with hundreds of engineers, became Checkout.com.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in Checkout’s $230M Series A alongside DST Global and Insight Partners. Checkout has since gone on to raise their $150M Series B, $450M Series C and $1B Series D.

description: Collective enables independent freelancers to team up by mutualizing skills, networks and work methodology in a quest to enable each other to achieve more as a group vs. individually.
tagline: Collective enables independent freelancers to team up by mutualizing skills, networks and work methodology in a quest to enable each other to achieve more as a group vs. individually.
long_description: Collective combines the benefits of working in an agency - because its SaaS platform automates much of back-office functions like proposals, invoices, contracts and payments - with the flexibility of still being freelance and thus able to pick and choose projects and clients. Collective was founded by Jean de Rauglaudre, Vianney de Drouas and Paul Vidal, as part of eFounders, and are based out of Paris.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Collective's $8M Seed round.

description: Comand AI is building an AI-native command and control platform for NATO countries and allies
tagline: Comand AI is building an AI-native command and control platform for NATO allies, using large language models to compress military planning from days to hours
long_description: Defence is entering a once-in-a-generation reset. Budgets are growing, force structures are shifting from personnel to systems, and legacy C2 software is no longer fit for machine-speed, multi-domain warfare. While most players focus on tactical control or incremental digitization, Comand AI is rebuilding the command layer itself, unlocking superhuman decision-making and enabling the transition to human-machine and fully autonomous operations. Comand AI was founded by Loïc Mougeolle and Quentin Le Pape, and later joined by Paul Mustière and Marie Inuzuka as co-founders, bringing together leadership from Palantir, OpenAI, and major defence primes to redefine the software layer of defence.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Comand AI's €32m Series A round.

description: Cowboy Space is building orbital infrastructure for the AI era: a fully integrated system of rockets and satellites designed to deliver high-performance compute and optical data transmission directly from Low Earth Orbit.
tagline: Cowboy Space is building vertically integrated orbital infrastructure for the AI era, spanning launch vehicles, space-based power and in-orbit compute.
long_description: As AI becomes ever more embedded into daily life, terrestrial data centres are hitting the limits of power they can supply. Cowboy Space Corporation is pioneering vertically integrated infrastructure to power and run AI compute in orbit, opening a new frontier for high performance computing. The company is developing a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that harness solar energy, a purpose-built launch vehicle to deliver them and compute payloads designed specifically for the space environment. In orbit, each upper stage becomes a 1-megawatt data center. Founder, Baiju Bhatt, co-founded Robinhood in 2013 together with Vlad Tenev. He and his team have pivoted from reshaping finance to building rockets and industrializing space infrastructure for the AI era.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in Cowboy Space's $275M Series B financing alongside Index Ventures.

description: Dija is a 10-minute grocery delivery service whose mission is to create the best online and offline convenience store experience for customers and shop owners. Acquired by GoPuff.
tagline: Dija is a 10-minute grocery delivery service whose mission is to create the best online and offline convenience store experience for customers and shop owners. Acquired by GoPuff.
long_description: Grocery delivery run by existing stores has always been frustrating; having to book a delivery slot weeks in advance, the risk of poor substitutions and often perishables close to their expiry date. Delivery has long been shoe-horned on-top of existing traditional retail stores which aren't setup for a great delivery experience, as grocery shoppping move online, it'll be delivery-first stores that will transform the market. Dija was founded by Alberto and Yusuf, who both worked at Deliveroo at senior levels for 4 years and saw the opportunity to improve grocery deliveries.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Dija's $20M Seed round. Acquired by Gopuff.

description: Duffel is an all-encompassing dev environment to make starting a travel business a seamless experience.
tagline: Duffel is an all-encompassing dev environment to make starting a travel business a seamless experience.
long_description: When airlines adopted ticketing technology in the late 20th century they were on the cutting-edge; unfortunately as technology has moved on airline now find the backend systems they rely on to be long antiquated. From travel agents to passengers, everyone in the industry has been frustrated by the backends that don't live up to the expectations of modern consumers. Duffel was founded by Steve Domin, an engineer and Tom Bates, a designer, who had both previously worked together as early employees at GoCardless.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Duffel’s $4.7M Seed round with participation from Y Combinator. Duffel has since gone on to raise their $21.5M Series A led by Benchmark and $30M Series B led by Index Ventures.

description: EquiLibre Technologies is a frontier AI trading research lab. They are building foundational models and reinforcement learning agents that trade billions of dollars every day.
long_description: EquiLibre is building reinforcement learning based AI trading systems that learn, adapt, and compete at the highest level. They are at the very frontier of AI research in trading - their models trade billions of dollars every day on the world's most challenging markets. Founders Martin, Matej and Rudolf all hold PHDs across algorithmic game theory and episodic memory modelling and all three spent time at DeepMind and IBM before joining forces to build EquiLibre.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in EquiLibre's seed round and they have since an A led by Creandum.

description: Fat Llama is the world's first fully insured digital P2P marketplace for the rental of physical items, enabling people to monetize their possessions. Fat Llama was acquired by Hygglo in August 2022.
tagline: Fat Llama is the world's first fully insured digital P2P marketplace for the rental of physical items, enabling people to monetize their possessions.
long_description: Millions of items from cameras to musical instruments sit unused for most of their lifetime, with increasing concerns about the environmental impact of consumerization, enabling sharing makes both economic and environemental sense. Owners can generate revenue from under-utilized assets and renters can borrow an item instead of purchasing.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Fat Llama’s $10M Series A round, with participation from Greylock Partners, Atomico and Y Combinator. Fat Llama was acquired by Hygglo in August 2022.

description: Finmid powerfully integrates financial solutions across products, removing barriers to revenue opportunities for businesses.
tagline: Finmid powerfully integrates financial solutions across products, removing barriers to revenue opportunities for businesses.
long_description: Traditional financing is characterised by strict regulatory requirements, slow processes and a narrow suite of options. Forward-thinking businesses demand fast, compliant and flexible solutions to offer an extensive choice of financing products. Finmid opens the door to new revenue opportunities through a seamless technical integration. Lending infrastructure and tailored data points are helping businesses overcome challenges for their customers, eliminating regulatory complexities whilst improving customer retention. Founders Max Schertel and Alex Talkanitsa joined forces at German neobank N26, refining customised infrastructure solutions for over half a decade. Finmid is their exciting new brainchild, widening access to rapid financing solutions grounded in best-in-class security protocols.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in finmid’s $12M Seed round alongside Earlybird. Finmid has since raised a $24.7M Series A led by Blossom.

description: Frankenburg Technologies is building redefined air-defence technology solutions for national defence and critical infrastructure.
tagline: Frankenburg Technologies is a defence tech company developing AI-powered, cost-effective missile and air-defence systems designed to be dramatically cheaper and faster to manufacture at scale than current industry solutions.
long_description: Frankenburg develops affordable, mass-manufacturable interceptor systems engineered for rapid industrial production. Its AI-powered relocatable, sovereign defence manufacturing model allows partner nations to establish local missile production capacity within weeks, enabling the production and replenishment of missile stocks close to the point of need and restoring industrial depth to European missile defence.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in Frankenburg's Seed round.

description: Freshly is a direct-to-consumer brand focused on natural cosmetics. After starting in Spain, Freshly has expanded to several other geos, and become an omni-channel company opening flagship retail locations in London, Madrid and Barcelona.
tagline: Freshly is a direct-to-consumer brand focused on natural cosmetics. After starting in Spain, Freshly has expanded to several other geos, and become an omni-channel company opening flagship retail locations in London, Madrid and Barcelona.
long_description: Consumers care more and more about using safe and natural ingredients, which is driving huge growth in demand for organic personal care products. Freshly's authentic brand, custom formulations, and direct-to-consumer business model, has made it a leading company in the organic beauty market. Freshly was founded by Miquel Antolin and Mireia Trepat, after learning about natural cosmetics from Miquel's family who used to make them at home.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Freshly's $21.8M Series A round.

description: Full-suite brand management platform allowing product and marketing teams to ensure brand consistency across geographies and channels.
tagline: Full-suite brand management platform allowing product and marketing teams to ensure brand consistency across geographies and channels.
long_description: Brands are increasingly a company's most valuable asset, whether targeting businesses or consumers, but maintaining consistency across thousands of brand assets and multiple teams and offices is close to impossible. But when companies want every customer touch-point to be perfect they need a solution. Frontify was founded by Roger Dudler, a former engineer who previously worked at a digital agency where he saw the challenges with brand management first-hand
fundraising_note: Blossom led Frontify’s $8.3M Series A round. Frontify have since gone on to raise their $22M Series B led by EQT Ventures and and $50M Series C led by Revaia.

description: Greenjets is a British aerospace technology company developing the propulsion systems, aircraft platforms and launch technologies that will shape the next generation of aviation.
tagline: Greenjets is a British aerospace technology company developing the propulsion systems, aircraft platforms and launch technologies that will shape the next generation of aviation.
long_description: A third revolution in aerospace is under way, defined by autonomy and electrification and accelerated by the wars in Ukraine and the Middle East. From low-cost drone interception to surveillance to long-range strike, autonomous aircraft are scaling at industrial speed, and propulsion has become the bottleneck. Greenjets is developing the foundational technologies that will shape the future of aviation enabling aircraft to be quieter, faster and more efficient. Co-founders Anmol Manohar and Dr Guido Monterzino have assembled a team that combines deep technical expertise from Rolls-Royce, General Electric, BAE Systems and Formula 1 with the operational discipline required to manufacture complex systems at scale.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Greenjet's $40m Series A round.

description: Harmonic are forging the world's most advanced mathematical reasoning engine.
tagline: Harmonic are forging the world's most advanced mathematical reasoning engine.
long_description: Harmonic has a big mission: to create mathematical superintelligence (MSI). MSI is artificial intelligence with mathematical capabilities superior to that of humans, and we believe its development will dramatically accelerate progress in quantitative domains including science and engineering.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in Harmonic’s $75M Series A alongside Sequoia Capital, they've since raised a $100M Series B led by Kleiner Perkins.

description: Inne’s mission is to become the platform for female health, starting with the world's first at-home fertility monitoring system.
tagline: Inne’s mission is to become the platform for female health, starting with the world's first at-home fertility monitoring system.
long_description: Hormones have a huge impact on our bodies and are critical for understanding important aspects of life like fertility. Understanding of hormone levels shouldn't just be restricted to medical professionals. Fertility tracking is the first step towards managing a woman’s entire reproductive cycle. Inne was founded by Eirini Rapti who previously worked in healthcare for International SOS.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Inne’s $8.8M Series A round.

description: Instruqt gives SaaS and developer-first companies the tools they need to create hands-on demos and live training workshops for prospects, buyers, customers and staff.
tagline: Instruqt gives SaaS and developer-first companies the tools they need to create hands-on demos and live training workshops for prospects, buyers, customers and staff.
long_description: Instruqt offers the simplest path to create interactive demos, workshops, and training that mirror real product experiences. It enables software companies to educate and sell to modern buyers and users with an authentic, immersive experience. Companies like Hashicorp, MongoDB, Red Hat, Okta, Datadog, and others use Instruqt to generate millions of dollars in the pipeline and account expansion. Since launching in 2018, Instruqt has hosted more than 1.6 million training and sales demos, built by more than 2,000 active content creators to more than a million engaged prospects and learners.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Instruqt’s $15M Series A round.

description: Kadmos is revolutionizing salary payments for migrant workers. Kadmos has developed a payroll platform for companies that employ migrant workers which allows them to distribute pay to e-wallet accounts controlled by the worker.
tagline: Kadmos is revolutionizing salary payments for migrant workers. Kadmos has developed a payroll platform for companies that employ migrant workers which allows them to distribute pay to e-wallet accounts controlled by the worker.
long_description: Kadmos uses cutting-edge financial technology to make the salary journey of millions of migrant workers more transparent, convenient, and cheaper for both employers and employees. Kadmos’ mission is to bring the latest financial technology to these underserved communities of workers to help them protect and secure their salaries so they are safely able to remit their pay home to their families. Kadmos was founded in February 2021 by Justus Schmueser and Sasha Makarovych. The pair created Kadmos after a relative of Makarovych’s, who worked as a seafarer, told him of the complexity and hardship involved in getting paid.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Kadmos' $31.9M Series A round. Acquired in June 2025 by NYK.

description: Localyze is an all-in-one platform that enables HR, employees & prospective hires to manage all administrative processes of a relocation.
tagline: Localyze is an all-in-one platform that enables HR, employees & prospective hires to manage all administrative processes of a relocation.
long_description: Relocation for work can be intensely stressful, visa processes opaque and confusing, both to employers and new hires. Solving the administrative headache not only enables companies to hire more efficiently, but great improves employee experience. As the talent market becomes ever more global, making international transitions seamless has never been as important. Localyze was founded by Hanna Asmussen, a former management consultant, Lisa Dahlke, a HR Specialist and Franzi Löw, a researcher in Industrial Economics.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Localyze's $12M Series A. Localyze has since raised a $35M Series B led by General Catalyst. Acquired by Boundless in September 2025.

description: Maki is building a conversational AI agent that liberates HR teams, advances organizations, and expands human potential. From sourcing and screening to interviewing and selection, Maki’s agents handle the entire journey autonomously and at scale.
tagline: Maki is building a conversational AI agent that liberates HR teams.
long_description: Maki’s AI enabled companies to solve critical talent acquisition and management challenges, including streamlining workflows, enhancing candidate experience, and accelerating time-to-hire. Maki was founded by Maxime Legardez who previously founded Everoad (acquired by Sennder), Paul-Louis Caylar, and Benjamin Chino and is based out of Paris.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Maki's $28.6M Series A.

description: Moonpay provides a fiat to crypto on-ramp, enabling merchants to offer customers the ability to exchange fiat-to-crypto currency immediately.
tagline: Moonpay provides a fiat to crypto on-ramp, enabling merchants to offer customers the ability to exchange fiat-to-crypto currency immediately.
long_description: Moonpay is democratising access to crypto, with its world-leading on-ramp solution. By giving developers the tools they need to onboard new crypto users in a fast, reliable and compliant manner, Moonpay will allow billions of users to create trillions of dollars of value in crypto. Moonpay was founded by Ivan Soto-Wright and Victor Faramond out of HODL, their crypto venture studio.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested prior to Moonpay's $555M Series A with Tiger Global, Coatue, Thrive, Paradigm, and NEA.

description: Pie enables developers to produce and consume APIs more effectively to build the tools, apps and technologies we rely on.
tagline: Pie enables developers to produce and consume APIs more effectively to build the tools, apps and technologies we rely on.
long_description: Whether it's exploring an API, testing it or using it to pull data, API users often go beyond developers to product managers, data analysts and others. As the world increasingly becomes API driven, interacting with and collaborating on APIs should be as easy at working with a website or mobile app. HTTPie was founded by Jakub Roztocil who previously founded the popular open-source project of the same name.
fundraising_note: Blossom co-led Pie's $6.5M Seed round alongside Coatue and Addition.

description: Pigment offers an intuitive, visually-driven experience to forecast the future of your business. With flexible parameters and continuous forecasting, Pigment brings future scenarios to life through charts, models and simulations.
tagline: Pigment offers an intuitive, visually-driven experience to forecast the future of your business. With flexible parameters and continuous forecasting, Pigment brings future scenarios to life through charts, models and simulations.
long_description: Financial planning is becoming ever more complex, yet the majority of enterprises still rely heavily on spreadsheets, which were never designed to be used at this scale with models with thousands of calculations and data sources. Better financial modelling not only reduces errors but also allows for more complex models which give businesses a better understanding of how they operate and more accurate forecasting. Pigment, based out of Paris, was founded by Eléonore Crespo, a former investor at Index Ventures and Romain Niccoli, who previously co-founded Criteo, solving a problem they'd both seen first hand.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Pigment’s $26M Series A round. Pigment has since gone on to raise $145M in a Series D funding round, led by ICONIQ Growth.

description: Praktika is an innovative language-learning platform transforming traditional lessons through ultra-realistic AI avatars to deliver personalised and fun educational experiences.
tagline: Praktika is an innovative language-learning platform transforming traditional lessons through ultra-realistic AI avatars to deliver personalised and fun educational experiences.
long_description: Dedicated to making language acquisition more accessible, engaging, and efficient, Praktika empowers learners to jumpstart their route to fluency with AI companions. At the heart of Praktika lies a sophisticated system that dynamically generates educational content into immersive, hyper-customised tutors. A broad range of virtual personalities–each with unique backgrounds, stories and accents–provide instant role-play feedback and tailored guidance to leverage the adaptive, responsive qualities of human tutors and maintain engagement. Praktika leverages a complex blend of conversational AI technologies through an app designed to accelerate a learner’s journey with specific grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation support covering a suite of topics. Based on 1,000 lessons and 150 real-world topics, Praktika confidently aspires to empower the next billion learners with friendly tools that help overcome language barriers. Founders Adam Turaev, Ilya Chemyakov and Anton Marin previously achieved several entrepreneurial milestones since founding next-gen AI startup Cleverbots. Praktika is their exciting new pursuit, born from the overlap of their complementary vision to open the doors of language acquisition with a groundbreaking avatar-based methodology.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Praktika’s $35.5M Series A round.

description: Qantev enables insurers to automate claims operations, reduce leakage, improve loss ratios, enhance data quality, and elevate customer experience.
tagline: Qantev enables insurers to automate claims operations, reduce leakage, improve loss ratios, enhance data quality, and elevate customer experience.
long_description: Founded in 2019 by former AXA lead data scientist, CEO Tarik Dadi and ex-quantitative analyst and CTO Hadrien De March , Qantev’s AI-driven software brings automation and efficiency to an industry facing rising costs, chronic disease and ageing populations. Qantev’s suite of AI-powered solutions is solving these challenges for customers by automating the claims process from days down to only minutes. The platform uses historical claims data to understand patient journeys and behaviours in individual markets before helping insurers across these regions make faster, more accurate decisions. As a consequence, doctors and nurses can focus on caring for their patients when not interrupted to fill pre-authorisation requests; inefficiencies and bottlenecks in workflows can be quickly identified and solved; operational costs can be reduced; and the scalable nature of Qantev’s technology helps insurers cope with increasing volume of claims without sacrificing quality, access or affordability.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Qantev's €28.5M funding round.

description: Spacelift integrates with popular Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management tools to allow you to customize workflows, automate manual tasks, reduce number of errors, improve security and auditability of your infrastructure.
tagline: Spacelift integrates with popular Infrastructure as Code (IaC) management tools to allow you to customize workflows, automate manual tasks, reduce number of errors, improve security and auditability of your infrastructure.
long_description: System outages are increasingly driven by infrastructure errors; as infrastructure becomes code, devops teams want the same level of control and governance that has long been available to their developer counterparts. Spacelift was founded by Marcin Wyszynski, an engineer who previously worked at Deliveroo, Facebook and Google and Pawel Hytry, who was an MD at Foodpanda.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Spacelift’s $6M Series A. Since then, the company has raised a $15M Series B from Insight Partners, followed by a $51M Series C.

description: Sqreen protects distributed applications against sophisticated attacks by automatically detecting and tracing vulnerabilities down to the line of code. Acquired by Datadog.
tagline: Sqreen protects distributed applications against sophisticated attacks by automatically detecting and tracing vulnerabilities down to the line of code. Acquired by Datadog.
long_description: Security is shifting-left - from the security team to the development team, but developers often don't have the expertise in making systems secure. The only way for security to become ubiquitous is for it to be as easy as adding a few lines of code. Sqreen, based out of Paris, was founded by Pierre Betouin and Jean-Baptiste Aviat, who both previously worked at Apple's Red Team.
fundraising_note: Blossom invested in Sqreen’s $14M Series A alongside Greylock Partners. Acquired by Datadog.

description: Superchat provides a messaging platform that allows small and medium-sized enterprises to communicate with their customers on Whatsapp, SMS, Facebook Messenger, and other services in a single interface.
tagline: Superchat provides a messaging platform that allows small and medium-sized enterprises to communicate with their customers on Whatsapp, SMS, Facebook Messenger, and other services in a single interface.
long_description: Consumer communication preferences have changed, and younger customers expect B2C interactions to be digital. SMEs want to meet customers where they are, not via phone or email, but don’t have tooling specific for their needs. Superchat aims to be the system of customer engagement for European SMEs. Superchat was founded by Yilmaz Köknar and Mika Hally, after seeing first-hand how overwhelming it can be for SMEs to juggle conversations across multiple channels.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Superchat's $15.6M Series A round.

description: TheyDo has created a Journey Management platform to connect people, processes, and products and turn them into opportunities for CX improvements across a company's customer journey.
tagline: TheyDo has created a Journey Management platform to connect people, processes, and products and turn them into opportunities for CX improvements across a company's customer journey.
long_description: Journey Management is an approach TheyDo devised that brings instant customer and company alignment. TheyDo scales service design by putting every decision in a journey-centric framework — showing precisely how journeys cut through teams, products, and services. In 2019, Jochem van der Veer, Charles Beaumont, and Martin Palamarz transformed TheyDo from a consultancy company to a user-friendly software platform for customer journey management.
fundraising_note: Blossom led TheyDo's $12.7M Series A round. TheyDo has since raised an additional $34M.

description: Tines makes the lives of security and operations teams on the frontlines easier through advanced, contextually aware automation. Connect to any REST API or web application in seconds.
tagline: Tines makes the lives of security and operations teams on the frontlines easier through advanced, contextually aware automation. Connect to any REST API or web application in seconds.
long_description: Security teams are stretched as never before, yet a large part of a security analysts roles is routine work. By enabling analysts to automate their day-to-day work it allows them to focus on what really matters in defending their companies. Tines was founded by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella, who both previously worked in the security teams at Docusign and Ebay, building the product they wished they had in their previous jobs.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Tines’s $4.1M Series A. Tines has most recently raised a $125M Series C from Goldman Sachs.

description: Trebellar is the AI platform for corporate real estate, unifying fragmented data on people, places, and costs so enterprises can ask complex questions and make faster, smarter portfolio decisions.
tagline: Trebellar is the AI platform for corporate real estate, unifying fragmented data on people, places, and costs so enterprises can ask complex questions and make faster, smarter portfolio decisions.
long_description: Corporate real estate is the largest G&A function still without purpose-built, AI-native tools. Lease terms, floor plans, occupancy, and cost data sit scattered across disconnected systems, spreadsheets, and PDFs, with no common structure to reason across them. Result: renewal, consolidation, and investment decisions get made on imperfect data and gut feel. Trebellar built an AI platform on top of a purpose-built ontology that maps a company's real estate data into a single structure enterprises can query directly, turning analysis that used to take analysts weeks into answers in minutes.Trebellar was founded by two veteran engineers from Salesforce and Google, Diego Ferreiro Val (CEO) and David Garcia Quintas (CTO), after an early concept in consumer smart-home data surfaced a much larger enterprise opportunity. They were joined early by Adam Sewall as co-founder leading go-to-market and operations. Enterprise customers include Meta, Uber, Workday, Okta, Cohesity, and Merck.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Trebellar's $18m Series A round.

description: Vespa.ai provides an AI-based search platform that allows applications leveraging AI and data online to store, search, and apply unlimited quantities of data to meet their users’ needs in real time.
tagline: Vespa.ai provides an AI-based search platform that allows applications leveraging AI and data online to store, search, and apply unlimited quantities of data to meet their users’ needs in real time.
long_description: Vespa is a fully featured search engine and vector database. It supports vector search (ANN), lexical search, and search in structured data, all in the same query. Integrated machine-learned model inference allows you to apply AI to make sense of your data in real time. Together with Vespa's proven scaling and high availability, this empowers you to create production ready search applications at any scale, and with any combination of features. Vespa offers an integrated approach for applying AI to data during serving time, using vectors, tensors, text, structured data or any combination to provide high-quality solutions catered to diverse use cases, from search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to recommendation and ad targeting. Vespa takes responsibility for the needs of applications from end to end, including managing the data and performing model inferences directly where it resides, allowing applications developed on Vespa to scale to any amount of data, load or complexity.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Vespa.ai’s $31M Series A round.

description: Zevoy is the all-in-one expense management app simplifying company spending.
tagline: Zevoy is the all-in-one expense management app simplifying company spending.
long_description: Zevoy is an expense management solution powered by Zevoy’s Business Card. Their technology, offered as a SaaS service, combines a business card, a receipt scanning app, and administration portal into one seamless expense management solution. The core mission of Zevoy is to provide companies with efficient and simple alternatives to company spending by offering an all-In-one service linking smart payment cards with expense management. The company can do instant issuing, physical or virtual (Apple Pay, Google Pay), credit or prepaid cards. Zevoy is an Electronic Money Institution (EMI) authorized and supervised by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority.
fundraising_note: Blossom led Zevoy's $16.5M Series A round.
